data.title: Transaction Amount Clustering Near Reporting Threshold
data.description: Detects transactions that cluster just below regulatory reporting thresholds ($3,000 for international transfers, $10,000 for CTR filing). Structuring transactions to evade reporting requirements is itself a federal offense and a strong indicator of money laundering or fraud monetization.

queries.cql:
// CrowdStrike CQL for Transaction Amount Clustering Near Reporting Threshold
// Repository: flame-banking-transaction-monitoring
// Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma:
// Original condition: (selection_under_10k | count() by account_id > 2) or (selection_under_3k | count() by account_id > 2)
(event_type="WIRE_INITIATION" OR event_type="ACH_DEBIT" OR event_type="CASH_DEPOSIT")
transaction_amount>=9000
transaction_amount<10000
(event_type="WIRE_INITIATION" OR event_type="INTERNATIONAL_TRANSFER")
transaction_amount>=2800
transaction_amount<3000
| groupBy(account_id, function=[count(as=event_count)])
| event_count > 2
| groupBy(account_id, function=[count(as=event_count)])
| event_count > 2
